warnings: SBC SENSITIVITY -- THE VALUATION IS THIS ONE ASSUMPTION (added 2026-08-28). The base case requires SBC to fall from 19.5% to 7.0% of revenue over 10 years. Actual SBC as % of revenue: FY2020 19.0%, FY2021 16.1%, FY2022 17.7%, FY2023 21.2%, FY2024 21.0%, FY2025 20.9% -- six consecutive years in a 16-21% band with NO downtrend, and the three most recent are the highest of the six. Holding every other assumption identical and changing only the SBC path: model path (19.5%->7.0%) gives IV $33.69 (+47% vs $22.88); declining to 15% by Y10 gives $23.66 (+3%); FLAT at the FY2025 actual 20.9% gives $16.85 (-26%). The entire upside case is the assumed decline. Nothing in six years of reported history supports it. What would validate it: two to three consecutive quarters of SBC actually falling as a share of revenue (observable in each 10-Q).

Owner FCF (reported FCF less SBC expense, less cash tax withheld on RSU net-share settlement, less interest income) is NEGATIVE in FY2024 (-$343.1M), FY2025 (-$138.0M) and TTM through Q2-2026 (-$201.7M). Pinterest's reported free cash flow ($1.25B FY2025, 29.7% margin) is materially overstated as an owner-economics measure once the full cash cost of equity compensation is charged. The DCF below is built from a 10-year component projection (not the negative trailing FCF) because owner FCF only turns positive as SBC-as-%-of-revenue is assumed to decline from ~21% (FY2025) toward ~7% by year 10 -- an assumption, not a certainty. If SBC intensity does not moderate as management's own guidance implies (30-34% medium-term Adjusted EBITDA margin), intrinsic value is lower than shown.

Equity-award cash tax withholding ($399.0M FY2025) is unusually large relative to the $880.5M SBC expense (45%), consistent with high employee marginal tax rates on a stock that has appreciated; this is a real, recurring cash outflow in financing activities that reported FCF and Adjusted EBITDA both exclude.

inputs.sbc_source: 10-K/10-Q cash-flow-statement SBC add-back ($880.463M FY2025) + 'shares repurchased for tax withholdings on release of RSUs' financing-activity cash outflow ($398.982M FY2025, confirmed via Q3-2025 10-Q 9mo figure $314.260M + Q4-2025 presentation $84.722M = $398.982M). Pinterest does not publish a single combined 'SBC expense related to equity awards' reconciliation line, so the two components are summed per methodology.
inputs.debt_note: $1.0B (981.128M net carrying) 1.75% convertible notes due March 2031, issued to Elliott Investment Management March 2026 -- Pinterest's first-ever debt.

historical_growth.revenue_4yr_cagr_note: Only 4 years of clean annual revenue history available pre-FY2021 in the dataset; using FY2021-FY2025 (4yr) as the longer-horizon anchor.
historical_growth.growth_rate_source: equity_3yr_cagr, cross-checked against revenue_3yr_cagr (14.6%); used as the anchor for Year-1 base-case revenue growth, then decelerated per Q3-2026 guidance (13-15%) toward a 4% terminal rate
historical_growth.notes: Reported FCF 3yr CAGR (41.7%) is NOT a usable base-case anchor: it is inflated by working-capital timing and by SBC growing slower than cash flow in FY2022-23, then reverses sign entirely once SBC + equity-award cash taxes are deducted (owner FCF is negative in both FY2024 and FY2025, so no CAGR is computable). Revenue (14.6%) and equity (13.1%) CAGRs are closely aligned and used as the growth anchor instead; the forward margin path is built bottom-up per Step 1c rather than extrapolating any FCF trend.

base.entry_price_correction_note: Terminal value rebuilt at the hurdle rate 2026-09-01: min(Gordon@hurdle, cap x FCF_N). The superseded value held the WACC-built terminal value and varied only the discounting.

probability_weighted.weighted_iv_note: 23.66 adopted as the headline on 2026-08-28: the 'moderate' SBC path (20.9% -> 15.0% of revenue by Y10) from sbc_sensitivity_2026_08_28. The as-published 32.49 assumes SBC intensity falls from 19.5% to 7.0%, which six years of actuals (16-21% band, the three most recent the highest of the six) do not support; it is retained in weighted_iv_as_published. Flat SBC at the FY2025 actual gives 16.85. Owner FCF is negative today, so this single assumption is what makes the IV positive at all.
probability_weighted.weighted_upside_note: 1.1% is the headline weighted IV 23.66 against current_price 23.4. The as-published 38.8% belonged to the superseded 32.49 and was left behind when the headline was rebuilt on 2026-08-28; it is retained in weighted_upside_as_published. The +3.4% quoted in sbc_sensitivity_2026_08_28 is the same IV measured against the 22.88 price used in that note.

memo_sbc_as_noncash.description: Intrinsic value (base case) if SBC were treated as a non-cash expense with no economic cost to shareholders (i.e., only D&A/capex/tax/working-capital charged, SBC added back in full).

sanity_check.note: Multiples are SBC-adjusted on both sides (earnings/EBITDA minus SBC), so they will not match published GAAP P/E from screeners. SBC ($880M FY2025) exceeds EBITDA ($345M), so adjusted P/E and EV/EBITDA are negative/unavailable for nearly all years — P/Sales and P/B are the usable anchors for this name. FY2024 adj P/E 18.5x is distorted by the $1.7B deferred-tax valuation-allowance release and not used as an anchor.
sanity_check.diagnosis: No trip: implied P/Sales 5.09x is below the FY2019/22-25 average 6.12x and inside the historical range; implied P/B 4.53x is below the ex-outlier average 4.98x and far below the 17.5x max. Base upside +32% with price ($23.68) in the lower half of the 10y range ($15.44-$80.58).

sbc_sensitivity_2026_08_28.why_this_matters: Owner FCF is negative today (FY2025 -$138.0M, TTM -$201.7M). The DCF only produces a positive intrinsic value because SBC intensity is assumed to fall by two thirds. This is the single load-bearing assumption in the valuation.
sbc_sensitivity_2026_08_28.historical_verdict: Six years, 16-21% band, no downtrend; the three most recent years are the highest of the six.
sbc_sensitivity_2026_08_28.method: Base-case growth, EBITDA margin, D&A, capex, working capital, tax, WACC 10.5%, terminal growth 3.0% and the 20x cap all held identical; only sbc_pct_path varies.
sbc_sensitivity_2026_08_28.buyback_coverage: SBC incl. equity-award taxes $1,279.4M vs buybacks $927.0M -- a $352M shortfall, yet annual_share_growth_pct is set to 0. Shares did fall 1.5% FY2024->FY2025 (698.4M -> 687.8M) so flat is defensible on recent evidence, but this is NOT a buyback-covers-SBC situation (contrast WISE.L, where buybacks run ~5x SBC).
sbc_sensitivity_2026_08_28.other_anchors_unavailable: SBC ($880.5M FY2025) exceeds EBITDA ($345M), so SBC-adjusted P/E and EV/EBITDA are negative or unavailable for nearly every year. P/Sales and P/B are the only usable multiple anchors. FY2024 GAAP net income of $1,862.1M reflects the ~$1.6B deferred-tax valuation-allowance release, not operations; FY2025's $416.9M (9.9% margin) is the truer picture.
sbc_sensitivity_2026_08_28.what_is_genuinely_working: Revenue growth is real and re-accelerating: +8.7% FY2022, +9.0% FY2023, +19.3% FY2024, +15.8% FY2025, with Q2-2026 +18.2% YoY. Net cash $293.8M. Reported FCF is strongly positive and growing. If SBC is treated as non-cash, this is a good business at a fair price -- the disagreement is entirely about that treatment.
sbc_sensitivity_2026_08_28.verdict: Pass at $22.88 on an owner-earnings framework. The upside requires an unevidenced change in compensation policy; if it does not arrive the stock is ~26% overvalued rather than ~42% undervalued. A price nearer $17-18 (the flat-SBC valuation) would pay you to wait for evidence.
